import java.util.Scanner;

public class MinMovesCalculator {

    public static long computeMinMoves(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long prefix = 0, digitsCount = 0;
        while (prefix * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            prefix = prefix * 10 + 1;
            ++digitsCount;
        }
        long option1 = digitsCount * (n / prefix) + computeMinMoves(n % prefix);
        long option2 = digitsCount + 1;
        n = 10 * prefix + 1 - n;
        option2 += digitsCount * (n / prefix) + computeMinMoves(n % prefix);
        return Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long input = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(computeMinMoves(input));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
